evidence.mission_note: A pickup bed and 4x4 add capability the RX 350 lacks, but this is a 60-year-old drum-braked character truck with a disclosed oil-burning engine, not a dependable capability vehicle or second car for an accelerated bridge. At best it is a weekend hauler and collector piece.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes the truck's identity via a data plate photo (2406W50003, GVW 5000 lbs) and a stated Washington title in the seller's name. The odometer is a replacement, total mileage is unknown and the title is odometer-exempt. Observed problems are disclosed by the seller: engine blow-by and oil consumption, a trans/transfer-case leak, rear diff cover residue, a stretched parking-brake cable, visible corrosion, epoxy-fiberglass bed-side repairs, a wavy bed floor and a dented tailgate. A substantial 2020–2024 work list (brakes, ignition, fuel, heater, windshield, starter, exhaust, axle service) is claimed but no receipts are shown. The single rear underside photo shows surface rust on the axle and diff cover but does not cover the hangers, crossmember or cab mounts. Brake circuit type, front-knuckle condition, tire dates and PPI access remain open. The early-327 provenance and no-reserve format with heavy watcher interest suggest bidding will move well beyond the current $5,000.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller through BaT before Oct 26 asking for full under-truck and frame-stamping photos, compression numbers, the brake receipts with master cylinder circuit type, and permission for a Tacoma mobile PPI before the close.
